title: gopls Settings
description: Settings forwarded to gopls under the `gopls` section. See https://github.com/golang/tools/blob/master/gopls/doc/settings.md for the upstream reference. Only commonly tuned keys are defined here; additional properties are allowed.

buildFlags.description: Flags passed to the build system (e.g. ["-tags=integration"]).

directoryFilters.description: Directories to exclude from workspace scanning (prefix with - to exclude, + to include).

usePlaceholders.description: Enables placeholders for function parameters or struct fields in completion suggestions.

completeUnimported.description: Completes unimported packages and auto-inserts import statements.

gofumpt.description: Runs gofumpt instead of gofmt when formatting.

local.description: Prefix for local import paths to keep them grouped separately from standard library and third-party packages.
